def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    n = w // 2
    left_bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row[:n]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row[w - n:]).most_common(1)[0][0]

    return [
        [2 if grid[r][j] != left_bg or grid[r][w - n + j] != right_bg else 3
         for j in range(n)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
    left = [row[:n] for row in left]
    right = [row[:n] for row in right]

    def bg(panel):
        return Counter(x for row in panel for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    lb, rb = bg(left), bg(right)
    common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    shared = next(iter(common))

    if shared == lb == rb:
        return [
            [2 if left[r][c] != shared or right[r][c] != shared else 3
             for c in range(n)]
            for r in range(h)
        ]

    # Mark the occurrences of the shared color in the panel where it is foreground.
    panel = left if shared != lb else right
    return [
        [3 if panel[r][c] == shared else shared for c in range(n)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))

    def mode(panel):
        from collections import Counter
        return Counter(v for row in panel for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    lb = mode(left)
    rb = mode(right)
    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    color = next((v for v in shared if v != lb and v != rb), None)
    if color is None:
        color = next((v for v in shared if v == lb or v == rb), next(iter(shared)))

    return [
        [3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color
         for c in range(n)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the solid divider and split the panels.
    divider = next(c for c in range(w)
                   if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))

    # The non-divider color common to both panels is the output background.
    common = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    background = next(iter(common))

    return [
        [3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else background
         for c in range(width)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
